verdict.headline: The invoice generation fails consistently with a server error.

rootCause.statement: The billing API returns HTTP 500 on every run, pointing to a backend defect in the invoice endpoint.

reasoning.step: Every analyzed run failed, so this is a consistent defect rather than intermittent flakiness.
The error reports an HTTP 500 from the invoice endpoint.
The deterministic rule identifies a backend/API failure.

verdict.confidenceRationale: A consistent failure history and an explicit server error agree.

recommendedAction.action: Investigate the invoice endpoint for the HTTP 500 response and fix the underlying backend error.
recommendedAction.ticketDraft: Investigate and fix the HTTP 500 returned by the monthly invoice endpoint.
